policies.listing_requirements: To secure your booking, this rental operator requires a $200 upfront deposit made directly with the rental operator within 24 hours of your request being accepted.
policies.other_requirements: Monday to Friday pick up/drop off only. $200 cancellation fee applies if you cancel once the booking is confirmed. 50c per extra KM over the allowed amount

instructions.driver_request_instructions:
Your request will be answered within a day on weekdays, or the following working day during weekends or public holidays.  Please note that with our relocations a $3500 bond held on a credit card is required, reduction on the bond not available.
A $200 cancellation fee applies to any cancellations made from the time of booking, this cancellation will be made by the rental operator directly.
If the km allowance is exceeded a charge of 50c per extra km will apply.
instructions.driver_booking_instructions:
Please get in contact with Travellers Autobarn by phoning +61 1800 674 374 to provide credit card details for the $200 deposit. Over the weekend please call by Monday to secure or within 24 hours during the week days otherwise the booking will be cancelled.
Please note your relocation is NOT confirmed until we have discussed the terms by phone.

vehicle_type.name: HiTop Camper
vehicle_type.description:
Our Hi-Top campervan are 2003-2005 models with 2.4 litre, 4 cylinder engine, manual transmission and 60 litres fuel tank!

The Hi-Top is equipped with a double bed at the bottom and a single bed at the top (or storage if there are only 2).  It also includes a 35 litre water thank, 2 burner gas stove, power steering, air conditioning, microwave, 57 litre fridge, sink with electric pump, 2*240 V to charge electrical appliances, radio/cassette player or CD player, and an indoor and small attached out door tale.
